$comment: LLM layer settings (PLAN Phase 7). Read by src/lib/llm/config.ts. The model id can be overridden with GR_LLM_MODEL. The LLM never produces a number that enters the score: it proposes claim sentences (the rule engine decides), classifies archived diffs (keep / halve / drop a rule-found removal, never add one) and writes the summary text. temperature is sent only to models listed in temperatureModels: current models (Claude Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Opus 5.5) reject non-default sampling parameters with HTTP 400, so for them determinism comes from strict tool schemas, item-wise validation and recorded fixtures (docs/CHALLENGES.md C-5).
